llm_response.reason: The website ashishsahgal.shop pretends to be the official Christian Louboutin Monaco store but uses an unrelated domain and an individual's name, signaling imitation of a luxury brand. It promotes sales, discounts, and free shipping similar to typical scam tactics, yet lacks business legitimacy (company details, contact info, and proper privacy policy). These factors match scam characteristics such as non-existent companies, unusual branding, urgency/promotion tactics, and fake online shopping template use.
